reviewMethod: All 18 selected stored SVG files across the next five priority-eligible current-corpus papers were independently rehashed against the immutable read-only GitHub evidence artifact and checked for exact task/page/article/source DOI identity, original Figure/Scheme identity and independent caption, captureVersion/job identity, fixed media generation 1790082000000, content-addressed R2 key, actual byte length/type/dimensions, duplicate source/hash ownership, frozen public same-ID state and TOC separation. Every SVG was parsed, rendered and checked for script, foreignObject, event-handler, javascript/external href and external CSS URL content. Every image was visually reviewed against its owning caption and article theme for body-image role, unrelated/recommendation contamination, duplicate risk and legibility. Capture success, partial, transport and format checkpoints were treated only as provenance evidence, not semantic approval. No publisher request, R2/D1 write, direct import/repair, literature/card/title/scope mutation, userscript change or media-generation change was performed.
quality: All 18 selected files are exact stored SVG bytes with matching full SHA256, sizes and dimensions, rendered successfully, and contained no active or external content. Selected full hashes and source URLs have no cross-DOI ownership collision in the frozen evidence inventory. The frozen public media state contains distinct official TOCs and no same-ID body collision for all five papers. Partial article reports are handled per-image: JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c08653 remains 8/9, JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c13515 remains 1/5, and Organic Letters 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03266 remains 2/3, so only exact reviewed stored files are approved and missing images are not inferred. Organic Letters 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03215 is 4/4 and 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03411 is 3/3. Historical progress transport/format checkpoints are retained only as provenance and are not interpreted as VPN, R2, quota or publisher failures. Figure files are body-only and are not TOC substitutions; existing official TOCs remain untouched.
